name: Simons Observatory Collaboration
notes: SO has benefited from contributions of "more than 350 physicists, engineers, and technologists from more than 50 institutions around the world" (official About page, undated).

summary.plain: More than 350 physicists, engineers and technologists at over 50 institutions who built and run the Simons Observatory in Chile, formed from the Atacama Cosmology Telescope and Simons Array teams.
summary.technical: Collaboration building and operating the Simons Observatory (LAT and SATs) on Cerro Toco; drawn from the ACT and Simons Array/POLARBEAR teams; "more than 350 physicists, engineers, and technologists from more than 50 institutions".
